programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil

programme.title: Mast

programme.title: Baadshah

programme.title: The Real Hunter

programme.title: Anokhi Ada

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.desc: Gangsters: Chase a band of marauding locusts, watch the coconut octopus ambush its next meal and meet a flock of finches who've developed a taste for blood. (S1, ep 6)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly...
programme.desc: Watch Adele and Mick go up against an eastern brown, the second deadliest snake in the world, while Stu and Liv tangle with a carpet python. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly...
programme.desc: Launch into spring's snake surge with Liv and Stu, who intercept two male brown snakes duelling for mating rights at a construction site. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: Land Of Extremes: The Arctic is locked in darkness for nearly seven months of the year, but when the sun comes up, the polar region sparkles into life. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Arctic Secrets
programme.desc: Devon Island - Land Of Ice: The world's largest uninhabited island, Devon Island is so remote that scientists chose it to simulate conditions on Mars. Only the toughest survive. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Predators of the Great Barrier...
programme.desc: Tiger Shark, the Wandering Guardian: Tiger sharks rule the Great Barrier Reef. Join scientists as they uncover the secrets of these powerful predators and their vital role. (1 of 3)

programme.title: Africa's Wild Roommates: How...
programme.desc: ...Animals Share Bed and Board. When animals create homes in the African savannah, roommates - from insects to mammals - move in, and they all contribute something to the home.

programme.title: Secret Life Of The...
programme.desc: Meet The Devils: There is no creature on earth like the Tasmanian Devil. For these muscular marsupials, the mating season is a chance for males to show who is dominant. (Ep 1 of 2)

programme.title: Secret Life Of The...
programme.desc: Young Devils: Tasmanian Devils might have infamous reputations, but these spirited scrappers are committed parents and heroic defenders of their pouch-reared young. (Ep 2 of 2)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: First to Fly: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he follows the story of animals who defy gravity, starting with the first flyers: the insect. (1 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: Rivals: Mark Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday as he turns back the clock after meeting some critters who glide through life in Borneo. (2 of 3)

programme.title: David Attenborough's Conquest of the Skies
programme.desc: Triumph: In celebration of Sir David Attenborough's 100th birthday, see him turn his attention to the creatures that dominate our skies. (3 of 3)

programme.title: Jaguar Journals
programme.desc: Collar Complications: Rejoin the team for some post-rainy-season drama as they search for Ferinha, Fera and Badalo, whose tracking collars are missing. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: In the Extreme: Dive into the stunning underwater world of sharks and examine what makes these apex predators so successful and so deadly. (S1, ep 3)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: The Misfits Come of Age: The Misfit is a charismatic cub who has had a rough ride as he was bullied by his big brothers and rejected by his mother. (S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: The Leapard Who Changed Her Spots: Three-year-old Chipadzua is an entitled leopardess who should have left her mother's side more than a year ago. (S3, ep 4)
